releases.body:
## What's new in 0.3.0

- **One account connection is all Korok needs.** Cloning used to go over SSH, so Apply failed with `Permission denied (publickey)` unless you also had an SSH key registered with GitLab. Korok now clones and pulls over HTTPS using the token you connect in Settings — no SSH key, no `glab auth login`.
- **Existing clones are migrated automatically.** Repos already cloned over SSH get their `origin` retargeted on the next Apply (untouched if you've pointed it somewhere of your own).
- **Scope problems are caught at connect time.** A token that can list repos but not clone them is now rejected when you paste it, with a message saying what's missing, instead of failing later mid-Apply.

**Upgrading:** this needs a token with both `read_api` and `write_repository`. If yours is `read_api`-only, Sign Out in Settings and reconnect — the "Create a token…" link pre-selects both scopes.

Signed and notarized for macOS.
releases.bodyHtml:
What's new in 0.3.0

  • One account connection is all Korok needs. Cloning used to go over SSH, so Apply failed with Permission denied (publickey) unless you also had an SSH key registered with GitLab. Korok now clones and pulls over HTTPS using the token you connect in Settings — no SSH key, no glab auth login.
  • Existing clones are migrated automatically. Repos already cloned over SSH get their origin retargeted on the next Apply (untouched if you've pointed it somewhere of your own).
  • Scope problems are caught at connect time. A token that can list repos but not clone them is now rejected when you paste it, with a message saying what's missing, instead of failing later mid-Apply.

Upgrading: this needs a token with both read_api and write_repository. If yours is read_api-only, Sign Out in Settings and reconnect — the "Create a token…" link pre-selects both scopes.

Signed and notarized for macOS.

releases.body:
## What's new in 0.2.3

- **Automatic updates** — Korok checks for new releases once a day and offers to install them in place (Install & Relaunch). Downloads are verified against Jason's Developer ID signature before installing.
- **Check for Updates…** — run a check any time from the ⋯ menu.

Signed and notarized for macOS.
